card.name: Current or prior use of a medicine
card.fires_on: Words right after phrases about a patient already taking or having taken a drug, such as 'currently using', 'already been receiving', 'prior opioids' or 'dependent on'. Mostly opioid and MAO inhibitor warnings.

modes.label: Already on a drug
modes.description: Verb or linking word after 'currently', 'already been' or 'already being' describing ongoing therapy.
modes.example: Solution 100 mg per 5 mL (20 mg/mL) is for use in opioid-tolerant patients only who have already been<< receiving>> opioid therapy.

modes.label: Recent or past use
modes.description: Word inside phrases about prior or recent use of a drug class, often before the drug name.
